name: rule34video-downloader
description: Development scripts for the Downloader for Rule 34 MV3 extension. The shipped extension in extension/ has no build step and no runtime dependencies; everything here runs offline on the Node that CI already installs.

scripts.test: npm run test:fixtures && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check:syntax: bash -c 'cd extension && for f in popup.js player-button.js site-config.js update-notifier.js offscreen.js content.js content-bridge.js download-manager.js logger.js background-bridge.js folder-naming.js inject.js post-actions.js ../source/tools/generate-icons.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && for m in modules/*.mjs modules/*/*.mjs; do node --check "$m" || exit 1; done && node --input-type=module --check < background-enhanced.js'
